note: Set A captures several substantive facts that Set B omits entirely, notably the PV solar array, the 1/8" steel cable railing, the 1x4 T&G cedar siding/cladding details, and the A-511 Hardie installation reference, while both get the datum heights, solar envelope, APSE-20 tube model and 40-tube quantity right. Set B adds the door-swing note and the 1/4"=1'-0" scale, but it is padded with trivial identifier claims and three near-duplicate handrail claims and never mentions the PV array. Set A's weaknesses are two invented/vague bindings of 'PV SOLAR ARRAY' to a 'roof/upper structure' entity and one added 'relative to Grade Level' condition not in its quote; Set B's errors are mainly mislabeled 'height' attributes for the grade and finished-floor datums. Overall A is the more faithful and complete set.
